a: Full cost of Cambridge postgraduate study
dt: Oct 14, 2026, 11:59pm UK time (full application incl. references)
e: For US citizens living in the US who apply to a full-time Cambridge postgraduate degree; this is an earlier round, separate from the main round. US citizens studying or working abroad apply in the main round instead.

yale.t: No Yale endorsement is required: the Yale postgraduate awards grid does not mark it as needing Yale nomination. Apply directly to Cambridge by the October US-round deadline. Yale Office of Fellowships advises.
